name: DeLaurenti Classic Pig Tote
tagline: Instant market shopping cred - it carries anything, it doesn't care
description: Our ample sized canvas tote bag is a staple in our store and around the Pike Place Market! Fly your DeLaurenti colors while carrying what you need around town! Imagine the street cred! But wait, there's more - not only does this bag carry perfectly cut 1/2 pounds of prosciutto, olive oil and wine, it also carries tools, clothes, sunscreen and so much more!

name: DeLaurenti Classic Apron
tagline: As seen on every DeLaurenti employee!
description: Look great in the kitchen or at the barbeque while protecting your finest clothing from the natural risks of cooking! Defends against all the heavy hitters - red sauce, olive oil, a find dusting of OO flour...you name it! It even has handy pockets in front for your utensils, recipe cards, a black sharpie or a wine key!

name: DeLaurenti Classic Pig T-shirt - Sonic Green/Gold
tagline: Our ode to our beloved departed Seattle Super Sonics! Designed by Mystery Made in West Seattle!
description: You say you don't know what part of the pig your favorite cured cuts of meat come from? Well, you will now when you are wearing them on your chest! No skimping on the materials here. This is a top quality tri-blend shirt with a soft feel and a perfect fit. It's not too tight, but won't get in your way when you're cooking pasta or riding your bike! We're proud to say it was designed by the guys at Mystery Made in West Seattle!
